name: use-click-away
title: useClickAway
description: Supported touch events for the click-away listener.

types.name: ClickAwayMouseEventHandler
types.description: Supported mouse events for the click-away listener.

types.name: ClickAwayTouchEventHandler
types.description: Supported touch events for the click-away listener.

parameters.name: onClickAway
parameters.description: - The callback function to be called when a click outside is detected.

properties.name: disableReactTree
properties.description:
If `true`, the React tree is ignored and only the DOM tree is considered.
This prop changes how portaled elements are handled.

properties.name: mouseEvent
properties.description: The mouse event to listen to. You can disable the listener by providing `false`.

properties.name: touchEvent
properties.description: The touch event to listen to. You can disable the listener by providing `false`.

properties.name: ref
properties.description:
An external ref to merge with the hook's internal ref.
Useful if you need to access the DOM element outside of this hook.

returnType.name: { ref: React.Ref<Element>; listenerProps: Record<string, any> }
returnType.description: An object containing the `ref` to attach to the target element and `listenerProps` to spread.
